current_8b_run.method: NPO plus retain NLL, LoRA adaptation
current_8b_run.study_type: exploratory single-seed pilot; not confirmatory evidence and not a controlled scaling comparison

r3_main_study.final_gates: 4 of 5 passed; retain90 ROUGE-L non-inferiority gate failed because the 95% lower bound was -5.11 percentage points against a strict > -5 point threshold
r3_main_study.next_plan: Use a new public benchmark/cohort with unseen questions and entities; lock a new protocol before running confirmatory development/final cohorts.

scope_assessment.interpretation_rule: Treat the completed 8B outcome as a diagnostic of the implementation that actually ran. It is not an independent cohort replication, a controlled scale comparison, or evidence that the 3B ROUGE-L failure was resolved.
scope_assessment.what_it_can_test: The completed fixed 8B NPO-LoRA implementation moved the selected TOFU forget Truth Ratio in the expected direction, but utility gates failed and the executed retain weighting did not match the preregistered update-wide token mean.
scope_assessment.what_it_cannot_establish: It is not an independent cohort replication of R3, cannot isolate model scale, and cannot support a general claim that the prior IDK+AP retain ROUGE-L failure is resolved.

next_stage: MUSE-News feasibility audit completed; model-use terms and QA-to-article grouping remain blockers before training or inferential bootstrap.
